title: 2449. Minimum Number of Operations to Make Arrays Similar

examples.explanation: It is possible to make nums similar to target in two operations: - Choose i = 0 and j = 2, nums = [10,12,4]. - Choose i = 1 and j = 2, nums = [10,14,2]. It can be shown that 2 is the minimum number of operations needed.
We can make nums similar to target in one operation: - Choose i = 1 and j = 2, nums = [1,4,3].
The array nums is already similiar to target.
